checks.description: S11.A01 `len(SELECTABLE_BASES) == 127`. The order is SYN-001, C1, IAPWS-95, Wilson, then CoolProp in `FLUIDS` order. `tuple(SELECTABLE_BASES)` equals `selectable_bases()`.
S11.A02 For every entry `b`, `basis_provider(b).describe()` gives `(provider_id, components) == (b.provider_id, b.components)` (Wilson and CoolProp skipped with a reason when unavailable).

S11.A03 `component_basis` returns the expected basis for each registered `record_source`, and for each of the 123 CoolProp ids. An unregistered value (three probes, absent included) returns `SYN001_BASIS`.
S11.A04 CoolProp: two components, an unknown id, and each of the 13 excluded names are each `components_unsupported`, with the stated hint.

selectors: tests/test_s11_bases.py::test_a04_coolprop_refuses_other_than_one_admitted_fluid[components0-coolprop-heos-v1 serves exactly one admitted fluid per revision; got [CO2, N2]]
tests/test_s11_bases.py::test_a04_coolprop_refuses_other_than_one_admitted_fluid[components1-coolprop-heos-v1 serves exactly one admitted fluid per revision; got [Unobtainium]]
tests/test_s11_bases.py::test_a04_coolprop_refuses_other_than_one_admitted_fluid[components2-coolprop-heos-v1 serves exactly one admitted fluid per revision; got []]

checks.description: S11.A05 Molar masses: IAPWS-95 is `0.018015268`; each CoolProp `M` equals the table's; Wilson's equal the file's. Float equality in each case.
S11.A06 `s11_coolprop_records.py --check` is OK, and both record files validate against `component-record.schema.json`.

S11.A07 `wilson_premises` passes on the real records and on the verification records. For every component, each minimum rounded to 3 significant figures equals the `positivity` entry of `benchmarks/s10c/reference_values.yaml`: `dlnpsat_dT` (P1), `cp_liquid` (P2) and `cp_ig` (P3). For example, the real records give CH3OH 0.027 / 69.7 / 44.2 and H2O's c_p^0L 63.0 (S10C-spec §2.1). Any mismatch fails, and so does a minimum taken at a point that is neither an endpoint nor a real root of the stated cubic.
S11.A08 Mutation: the real records with T domain `[300, 800]` K give `basis_premises_unmet(wilson-ig-v1)`. The hint names P2 and H2O, with T in [750, 800] K.
S11.A09 With `find_spec("CoolProp")` patched to `None`, a CoolProp revision gives `basis_unavailable`. With the Wilson records path absent, a Wilson revision gives `basis_unavailable`.
S11.A10 A CoolProp revision with two components fails validation through COMP-02 with the code. A SYN-001 revision's validation report is byte-identical to the base.
S11.A11 The three routing models' SYN-001 manifests are byte-identical to the base (canonical SHA-256).

S11.A12 On each of IAPWS-95 (H2O liquid at 300 K, 1 MPa), CoolProp (CO2 vapour at 300 K, 1 bar) and Wilson (liquid at 330 K, 101 325 Pa), `feed → splitter(0.3) → 2 sinks` binds and solves `CONVERGED`. The material balance is exact (`==`). The outlet T and P equal the feed's. *Erratum 2026-10-27 (R-835):* restated as "within 2 ulp per component", with a registered non-exact Wilson case (0.4, 0.4, 0.8). See `docs/reviews/S11-rulings.md` item 6.

S11.A13 Every refused pair of §4.4 gives `model_unsupported(‹id›)`, with its reason. The syn001↔c1 hints are byte-identical to the base. *Erratum 2026-10-27 (R-841):* the hint names every basis the model binds on. Byte-identity holds only for models whose `MODEL_BASES` S11 leaves unchanged. See `docs/reviews/S11-rulings.md` item 12.
S11.A14 `syn001.cascade` is refused, with the hint.
S11.A15 `pr-lib-v1` records select SYN-001 and are refused `components_unsupported` (R-569 unchanged).
S11.A16 A12's three flowsheets with declared phases verify: every check is computed, and the splitter energy satisfies |value| ≤ energy tolerance.

S11.A17 The same flowsheets without declared phases: the energy checks are blocked with the unlifted note, and none passes silently. *Erratum 2026-10-27 (R-841):* restated. The binder refuses a `vapor_liquid` routing port (asserted), so the unlifted path is exercised on `revision_checks`. See `docs/reviews/S11-rulings.md` item 12.
S11.A18 The recording provider sees no `lnK` and no `h_‹c›` requested from a non-SYN-001 provider.
S11.A19 `fresh_provider` with a basis whose components disagree raises `basis_mismatch`.

S11.A20 In link mode, the declaration's DOF equals the standalone's. The link rows replace exactly the `(C + 2)·n_in` pin rows and add `2(C + 2)` product rows (plus one row and one column per recovery slot).
S11.A21 `links=None` gives a `ProblemSpec` identical (ids, parameters `float.hex`, kinds) to the base for S02 M1–M4, P1 and S06 J1–J8.
S11.A22 NaN guard: on a structural spec, every output of the five permitted functions is NaN-free.
S11.A23 The S08 and S10-C identity lines reproduce exactly.
S11.A24 For a column region, `continuation_parameter` qualifies the column's slot rows.
S11.A25 `UnitEvaluation(status != ok, owned={...})` raises. `_start_from_pass` is unchanged for every existing unit (identity family C).
S11.A26 The structural refusals at bind: one test per structural S/I item, in B1's inventory.
S11.A27 The Wilson column with a `purity` end gives `specification_unsupported(‹U›.condenser.purity)`.
S11.A28 Feed and phase contract: a revision with a column under a v1 policy gives `CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE phase_contract_unsupported(syn001.column)`.

S11.A29 (G6) `feed_source(s) → column → 2 product_sinks`, with the feed pinned to each registered standalone case's inlets, reproduces the registered standalone values. This covers S02 M1–M4; S06 J1–J8 (inverse, through §4.7.4); S10 C-MW and C-EW (Wilson). Every product flow, T, P, Q₁ and Q_N is within that case's registered state tolerance, measured as max |Δ|/tol ≤ 1. The global EO solve takes ≤ 3 Newton iterations from the traversal start. One SYN-001 recycle case (bottoms split 0.2 back to a side feed) converges and verifies.
S11.A30 The W27 v1 and v2 outputs on every registered state are byte-identical.
S11.A31 v3 refuses a duplicate route key, and admits 123 CoolProp routes with distinct keys.
S11.A32 `w27_registration_v3.py --check` is OK.
S11.A33 An IAPWS-95 route row reads CAS `7732-18-5` from `benchmarks/s05/components.yaml`.
S11.A34 The providers axis is the five ids; `LIBRARY_ONLY_PROVIDERS == {"pr-lib-v1": "S04"}`.

S11.A35 The A29 cases' certificates verify: material ≤ the molar_flow tolerance, energy ≤ the energy tolerance, specifications within tolerance, and every stage item passes. *Erratum 2026-10-27 (R-831):* on Wilson, the derivative witness differences absent-component zero columns with a forward five-point stencil, so C-MW, C-EW and the stripper can verify. R-281 is unchanged. See `docs/reviews/S11-rulings.md` item 2.
S11.A36 Mutation: `Q₁ += 10 ×` energy tolerance in `x_final` makes `energy_balance.‹U›` FAIL. Swapping one stage's `T` with its neighbour's makes the residual and stage checks FAIL.
S11.A37 For C-MW and C-EW, `phase_stability.‹U›.stage.‹j›` passes at every stage.
S11.A38 A recovery check with `F_c = 0` at `x_final` (constructed) FAILs.
S11.A39 `set(MODEL_BASES) == set(MODEL_BUILDERS) == set(MODEL_SIGNATURES)` has 23 members, and `MODEL_BASES["syn001.column"] == {"syn001", "wilson-ig-v1"}`.
S11.A40 The W27 v3 snapshot of the S11 build equals S4: 127 routes, with no `SnapshotUnsupportedError`.
S11.A41 The served MCP tool-list digest is unchanged.

S11.A42 Saturation. H2O on `iapws95-v1` at P ∈ {1e3, 1e4, 101 325, 1e6, 1e7} Pa: T_s, h^φ_sat and s^φ_sat equal the reference within |ΔT| ≤ 2e-6 K and 2e-8 relative. [T_s(101 325 Pa) = 373.1243 K ± 1e-3; Δh_vap = 40.65 kJ/mol ± 0.02.] The same at three CoolProp fluids (CO2, R134a, N2) on `coolprop-heos-v1`.
S11.A43 PH closure. H2O on a grid covering: - subcooled liquid, β ∈ {0, 0.25, 0.5, 1}, superheated vapour; - supercritical (25 MPa, 700 K) and low pressure (1 kPa).
S11.A44 PS closure. The same grid and tolerances, in s.

S11.A45 Acceptance. `declared_state` follows §4.2's table in every cell (3 declarations × 3 regimes), and: - β = 0 and β = 1 exactly are accepted as saturated; - a declared-liquid state 1e-7 relative to the vapour side in P is refused; - `declared_admissible` agrees with A3's verifier rule on a 200-point grid.

S11.A46 Jacobians. Each block's Jacobian against central differences (relative step 1e-6) agrees to ≤ 1e-6 relative at 20 states per block. The saturated blocks include P within 1e-6 of the range ends. *Erratum 2026-10-27 (R-834):* restated. The comparison is scaled, and identities pin the small entries. The two near-top states are judged at a fixed 1e-5 above the measured Maxwell floor; the adaptive floor is reverted. See `docs/reviews/S11-rulings.md` item 5.

S11.A47 Refusal mapping. `PhaseFlowBlock(LIQUID)` at 1e-3 relative superheat raises `DomainError`, which the compiled problem reports as `invalid_trial_state`. An unknown property raises `RuntimeError`.
S11.A48 Dormant rule. At n = 0, the values are 0.0 and the T and P entries are 0.0, and the n entry follows §4.3 in each of its three cases.
S11.A49 Isentropic identities. For `pure-single/single`: ∂Hs/∂T_I = n·T_s·c_p,I/T_I and ∂Hs/∂P_O = n·v_s, each to 1e-8 relative.
S11.A50 DOF and refusals. Every admitted mode and form gives a square contribution, and every §4.4 refusal gives its code and hint.

checks.description: S11.A51 Throttling. Saturated liquid H2O at 1 MPa (a β = 0 stream) through `thermal.valve` to 0.1 MPa: β equals the reference ≤ 1e-7 [0.1528 ± 5e-4], with T = T_sat(0.1 MPa).

S11.A52 Heater. - (i) Quality 0 → 1 at 101 325 Pa: Q = n·Δh_vap, ≤ 1e-8 relative to the reference. - (ii) T mode, subcooled liquid to superheated vapour: Q against the reference. - (iii) Duty mode landing at β = 0.5: β against the reference. - (iv) Duty mode declared `liquid` whose closure is SATURATED: `phase_regime_mismatch(‹S›)`, and the message names `vapor_liquid`.
S11.A53 Turbine. Steam at 3 MPa, 673.15 K → 10 kPa, η = 0.85: β_s, the outlet β and W equal the reference ≤ 1e-7 relative [x_s = 0.8366 ± 5e-4; x₂ = 0.9017 ± 5e-4; W = −15.91 kJ/mol ± 0.02].
S11.A54 Pump. Saturated liquid at 10 kPa → 3 MPa, η = 0.75: W and T_O against the reference [W = 72.5 J/mol ± 0.3].

S11.A55 Compressor. - CO2 at 300 K, 1e5 → 5e5 Pa, η = 0.8: W and T_O against the reference (≤ 1e-7 relative, ≤ 1e-5 K). - A dry fluid's saturated vapour, whose isentropic state at P_O is two-phase, gives `isentropic_state_two_phase(‹U›)`. C3 picks the fluid from the S07 table (for example n-Pentane, 1 → 3 bar) and logs it.
S11.A56 Mixer. - Superheated vapour and subcooled liquid H2O at equal P make a saturated outlet: β and the energy balance close. - A dormant inlet leaves the other inlet's state.
S11.A57 Drum. Wet steam at β = 0.3, 0.5 MPa, ΔP = 0, Q = 0: n_V = β·n and n_L = (1 − β)·n within τ_flow, and both products at T_s.
S11.A58 Carriage. A saturated outlet's `vapor_fraction` and owned columns satisfy V = β·n and L = n − V bitwise. A heater after a valve reads it, and its duty equals the reference.

S11.A59 TH-C1, Rankine once-through on `iapws95-v1`. Feed of liquid at 10 kPa, 318.15 K → pump (3 MPa, η 0.75) → boiler heater (T mode, 673.15 K, vapour) → turbine (10 kPa, η 0.85, `vapor_liquid`) → condenser heater (quality 0) → sink. - CONVERGED, VERIFIED. - |W_p + W_t + Q_b + Q_c − (Ḣ_sink − Ḣ_feed)| ≤ 5 τ_E. - The efficiency (−W_t − W_p)/Q_b equals the reference cycle ≤ 1e-7 relative.

S11.A60 TH-C2, refrigeration on `coolprop-heos-v1` R134a. Vapour at 0.2 MPa, 270 K → compressor (1 MPa, η 0.75) → condenser (quality 0) → valve (0.2 MPa) → evaporator (quality 1) → sink. The COP equals the reference ≤ 1e-7 relative; VERIFIED.

S11.A61 TH-R1, recycle on H2O. - Flowsheet: feed liquid at 0.5 MPa → mixer → heater (duty) → valve (0.2 MPa, `vapor_liquid`) → drum. The drum liquid goes → pump (0.5 MPa, liquid) → splitter (0.5) → back to the mixer, and the purge to a sink. The drum vapour goes to a sink. - CONVERGED, VERIFIED. - The flows and T equal the reference script's own sequential-modular solution (CoolProp PH/PS flashes, tear to 1e-12) within 1e-6 relative and 1e-5 K. - C6 fixes the feed and duty so that 0.1 < β < 0.9 at the drum, and logs them.

S11.A62 Dormancy. A splitter fraction of 0 before a `thermal.heater` (duty mode, liquid outlet), under `T05b-phase-contract-v2`: - with Q_spec = 0: CONVERGED with the label row; - with Q_spec = 1 kW: `SPECIFICATION_CONFLICT` `zero_flow_conflict(‹U›:TH-energy)`.

S11.A63 Mismatch. A valve declared `liquid` whose closure is SATURATED: the traversal refuses with `phase_regime_mismatch(‹S›)` and the hint "declare vapor_liquid". With the declaration corrected, it converges. *Erratum 2026-10-27 (R-839):* the plan's message carries the first line only. The hint is asserted on the valve's own answer. See `docs/reviews/S11-rulings.md` item 10.

S11.A64 Every A59–A61 certificate is VERIFIED with every check computed. The saturated streams carry passing `.saturation` and `.fraction` checks, and the energy checks carry the carried-split qualification.

S11.A65 Mutations at x_final: - V += 10 τ_flow with L −= 10 τ_flow on a saturated stream makes the producer's and reader's `energy_balance` FAIL; - T_S += 2e-6 K makes `.saturation` FAIL; - W × (1 + 1e-6) on the TH-C1 turbine makes `specification.‹U›.isentropic_work` FAIL (0.016 W ≫ τ_E).
S11.A66 Independence. With `models.thermal.kernel` patched to raise, `verify_revision` still verifies TH-C1.
S11.A67 D1 identity: - G1 PASS; - the five modules' SYN-001 manifests equal the base's except `implementation_artifact.artifact_hash`; - every K02, T05 and T05b test passes unchanged.

S11.A68 On the verification and the real records, each of the five units builds a square contribution with `GammaPhiLnKBlock` fed by the liquid flows and mixture enthalpy blocks. A recording provider sees no `lnK` and no `h_‹c›` request. *Erratum 2026-10-27 (R-836):* "square" is restated as SYN-001's ids and counts (33/32 and 16/15 on both bases), with the blocks swapped and every row vanishing at the evaluated state. See `docs/reviews/S11-rulings.md` item 7.

S11.A69 GP-C1. A liquid feed with S10 C-MW's composition at 330 K, 101 325 Pa → `tp_heater` (lifted outlet) → `tp_flash`. - CONVERGED, VERIFIED. - The flash products equal the provider's own TP flash at the solved (n, T, P) within τ_flow per component. - The energy balances are ≤ τ_E.
S11.A70 GP-C2. Valve → `ph_flash`: the PH flash's T and split equal `ph_state` at the same inputs within T05b §5.3's closure tolerances, and |Ḣ_in − Ḣ_out| ≤ τ_E across the valve.
S11.A71 GP-C3. A mixer of two liquids → heater, with the outlet admissibility through `single_phase_admissible`; VERIFIED.

S11.A72 Limiting case. VB–VC at their azeotrope at 101 325 Pa (verification records; the azeotrope state registered in `benchmarks/s10/reference_values.yaml`), as a `tp_heater` outlet at the azeotropic T: temperature-degenerate, `independent_split` `not_applicable(temperature_degenerate)`, and VERIFIED.
S11.A73 `GAMMA_PHI_UNITS` and `DECLARED_MIXTURE` give identical checks on A3's Wilson flowsheets and on B4's column certificates.
S11.A74 Mutation. Swapping two components' v_i in a Wilson lifted split makes `independent_split` FAIL and makes the admissibility or residual checks FAIL.

S11.A75 Delegation. At every state of `benchmarks/s10/reference_values.yaml` and of the S10/S10-C test grids, on both record files, v2's h and `lnphi_‹c›` (values and derivatives), its flash results and its `stability` reports equal v1's (`float.hex`).
S11.A76 Closed form. s equals the 50-digit reference within 1e-13 relative at ≥ 30 states: both phases, both record files, one state with a zero mole fraction.

S11.A77 Identities. - (i) ∂s/∂T = (∂h/∂T)/T to 1e-10 relative, using v1's h derivative. - (ii) ∂s^L/∂P = 0.0, and ∂s^V/∂P = −R/P to 1e-15 relative. - (iii) For each pure component at T ∈ {310, 350, 390} K and P = P_i^sat(T): s^V − s^L = (h^V − h^L)/T to 1e-12 relative (equal Gibbs energies at saturation). *Erratum 2026-10-27 (R-836):* restated. The 8 in-domain pairs are judged, the other 10 are refused `out_of_domain`, and all six components are covered. See `docs/reviews/S11-rulings.md` item 7. - (iv) The isentropic-enthalpy block's Jacobian against central differences, as A46.
S11.A78 Any n-derivative of s at a zero mole fraction is refused `derivative_singular`; the T and P derivatives are answered.

S11.A79 D5. - The Wilson `SELECTABLE_BASES` entry's provider is `wilson-ig-v2`, and the count stays 127. - Every Wilson-basis S11 test passes unchanged (first pass A12 Wilson, A16, A29 C-MW/C-EW, A35–A37). - The column cases' x_final equal the pre-switch values (`float.hex`).

S11.A80 GP-M1, compressor on Wilson vapour (real records; vapour at 370 K, 40 kPa → 50 kPa, η = 0.8). The outlet must stay inside the records' domain (≤ 400 K) with a dew-point margin of at least 5 K at both ends. D6 checks this and logs it, and may lower P_O, keeping P_O/P_I ≥ 1.1. - W equals Σ_j n_j[h_j(T_s, P_O) − h_j(T_I, P_I)]/η, with T_s from the verifier's bisection, within τ_E. - The outlet's `stability` is STABLE_WITHIN_TESTED_SCOPE.

S11.A81 GP-M2: a turbine whose outlet would be two-phase is refused `phase_regime_mismatch` or `isentropic_state_two_phase`. `thermal.pump` on Wilson is refused `model_unsupported(thermal.pump)` with the no-volume reason.

S11.A82 Registries. `set(MODEL_BASES) == set(MODEL_BUILDERS) == set(MODEL_SIGNATURES)` has 30 members. The admission equals §4.7, and every refused pair gives `model_unsupported(‹id›)` with its reason.

S11.A84 W27 v3. The seven model functions; `w27_registration_v3.py --check` OK; S4 has 127 routes and the Wilson route on `wilson-ig-v2`; v1 and v2 outputs byte-identical.
S11.A85 G1 PASS on the final tree, and the S08 and S10-C lines reproduce.
S11.A86 Every thermal model has a bound sample instance, as the edge-identity and signature tests require.

S11.A87 (inert). On the M02 flash revision and one T05 heater→flash revision, `region_splits(...)` gives `splits == lifted_splits(instances, components)` and `owners == {}`. Each map equals, with the same key order, the registry function's output for the same arguments.

S11.A88 (placement). On M1: - the plan's `solve_eo` `units` holds no stage key; - `signature_units == tuple(stage_unit("UCOL", j) for j in equilibrium stages)`; - the active splits number N_eq; - attempt 0's lifted signature keys equal `signature_units`, in order.

See `docs/reviews/S11-rulings.md` item 9.

limitations: L-S11-1: `iapws95-v1` (IAPWS-95, S05) is selected by `record_source: benchmarks/s05/components.yaml` for the one component H2O, over 273.16–1273.15 K and 10²–10⁸ Pa. The routing models (`syn001.feed_source`, `syn001.product_sink`, `syn001.stream_splitter`) and the seven `thermal.*` models (L-TH-1..8) bind on it; its evidence is S05's validation against the IAPWS-95 reference equation (S05 spec).

L-S11-2: `coolprop-heos-v1` (CoolProp HEOS, S07) is selected by `record_source: benchmarks/s07/components.yaml` for exactly one admitted fluid per revision, among the 123 of S07's table; each fluid keeps S07's tier and domain. The routing models and the seven `thermal.*` models (L-TH-1..8) bind on it, and it needs the `coolprop` extra: without CoolProp installed, binding is refused `basis_unavailable(coolprop-heos-v1)`.

L-S11-3: `wilson-ig-v2` (S10's Wilson activity model with an ideal-gas vapour; `wilson-ig-v1`'s answers with the molar entropy added, S11 units design §4.6) is selected by `record_source: benchmarks/s10/records.yaml` for its three record components (CH3OH, C2H5OH, H2O, in any order), over 300–400 K and 30–200 kPa. The routing models, the column (`syn001.column`, L-COL-1..10), the five K02/T05 units with γ–φ faces and the vapour machines `thermal.compressor` and `thermal.turbine` (L-GP-1..3) bind on it. Its records are in the source repository only, so in a wheel binding is refused `basis_unavailable(wilson-ig-v2)` (R-706, R-811). Premises P1–P3 are checked at binding. The S10 VAL-1–3 bands apply, and the VAL-3 latent-heat miss (methanol, +5.72 % against 5 %) is carried. Results are compared across architectures by tolerance, not bitwise.

L-COL-1: The column's feeds are single-phase and declared: one side feed per stage, none at a slot stage (S01 DECISION 8, S02 §1.4), and every side feed on its `feed` port shares one declared phase (the revision reader's one phase per port). A two-phase feed needs a flash and two stages.
L-COL-2: The column has no side draws, pump-arounds, stage efficiencies or hydraulics, and is solved by S02's Newton method only: no inside-out or rate-based method (S02 §14).
L-COL-3: A total condenser gives saturated liquid (no subcooling); there is no total reboiler.
L-COL-4: On `wilson-ig-v2` the column's end specifications are ratio, rate and duty only: a purity, recovery or temperature end is refused at binding (S10-C D8).

L-COL-5: No uniqueness, multiplicity or feasibility claim for a column beyond S06 §14: a certificate holds at the converged state, and an inverse specification's feasibility is decided only on S06's registered band.
L-COL-6: In a flowsheet a purity end's tolerance acts on the mole fraction directly (`|x − x*|` ≤ the molar-flow tolerance ÷ 1 mol/s, the `F_ref` meaning); the standalone column's acts on `F·x`.
L-COL-7: On `wilson-ig-v2` the column's Stage B (S08's block re-entry) is tested at the opening level only (S10-C).
L-COL-8: SYN-001 columns are synthetic (L18): their results are verified, never validated.

L-COL-9: In a flowsheet a column region has no edge-3 continuation (no revision region has one). The unit's own `evaluate` keeps S02's full standalone path, S08 Stage B included, so the traversal start is the standalone answer.
L-COL-10: A column under a PTC policy (`T08-ptc-v1`) ends `PTC_MAPPING_INVALID` before any attempt: the PTC mapping does not cover the column's stage variables.
L-TH-1: Pure-fluid stream regimes are declared (liquid, vapor, vapor_liquid = saturated); a closure in another regime is refused `phase_regime_mismatch`.
L-TH-2: Saturated pure-fluid streams are produced only by `thermal.*` units; there are no wet feeds, and routing models do not carry them.
L-TH-3: `thermal.flash` needs a two-phase state at drum pressure; its products are declared `vapor_liquid`.

L-TH-4: Machine phase rules (S11 units design §4.4 table); a compressor with a two-phase isentropic state is refused. In a revision, a turbine's isentropic state takes the outlet's declared form. A vapour outlet whose isentropic state is two-phase is refused `isentropic_state_two_phase({U})`.

L-TH-5: The near-critical box and the supercritical label rule of S05 §4.2 and S07. A supercritical PH or PS closure whose root lies at the provider's label switch (T = T_c) returns `not_converged` (measured: 4 of 11 200 grid outcomes, at 22.85 MPa).
L-TH-6: No regime discovery for pure fluids.
L-TH-7: Dormant single-phase thermal outlets need T05b's v2 phase contract.

L-TH-8: A revision declares one phase per port (R4), so a `thermal.mixer` takes inlets of one declared phase. Mixing a liquid with a vapour is available by direct construction only, as L-COL-1 is for the column's side feeds.
L-GP-1: On Wilson (`wilson-ig-v2`), only the five K02/T05 units and the two machines; no pump (no liquid volume); exchanger, separator and reactors refused.
L-GP-2: Wilson machines are single-phase vapour, within the records' domain (300–400 K, 30–200 kPa).
L-GP-3: A Wilson TP flash near an azeotrope has an E-2 noise floor (S10 §14); a temperature-degenerate split is judged on its stored split.

T07 THM-09/4 (R-796): the uncapped THM-09/4 length is pinned on ref-x86-64 and ci-aarch64 only; ci-x86-64 and unregistered machine classes assert len > max(K) and run every record-k interrupt check against their own uninterrupted run.
